abilities.name: Spoofed Badge
abilities.description: Hold a blank keycard against a door reader for ten seconds to copy the last badge that opened it.
abilities.cost: Burns out the blank card; the copy works for one hour

growth.grows: how secure a door and how long the copy lasts

abilities.name: Camera Blind Spot
abilities.description: Read a room's camera layout at a glance and know where to stand so nothing records your face.
abilities.cost: Needs a moment of stillness; useless in crowds

growth.grows: how many cameras and how fast you read them

abilities.name: Wetware Overclock
abilities.description: Push your implant for ten seconds so your reactions are sharper than anyone in the room.
abilities.cost: Nosebleed and a migraine that lasts an hour

growth.grows: how long the burst lasts and how fast it makes you

abilities.name: Payroll Trace
abilities.description: Read a corp employee's ID chip with a cheap reader and see who signs their pay.
abilities.cost: The read leaves a log entry someone may notice

growth.grows: how far up the chain you can follow

abilities.name: Drone Whistle
abilities.description: Call a delivery drone down to you with a burst of signal and borrow its camera for a minute.
abilities.cost: Needs a handset with charge; the drone's owner gets an alert

growth.grows: how big a drone and how long you keep it

abilities.name: Static Skin
abilities.description: Release a pulse from your palm implant that crashes small electronics within arm's reach.
abilities.cost: Implant overheats and burns the skin around it

growth.grows: the reach of the pulse and how hardened a device it kills

abilities.name: Street Price
abilities.description: Glance at any black-market item and know what it sells for on this block today.
abilities.cost: Wrong when the deal crosses into another gang's turf

growth.grows: how many districts' prices you know

abilities.name: Ghost Ping
abilities.description: Send a fake call to a target's handset so they answer and stand still for a few seconds.
abilities.cost: Uses a burner number that cannot be used again

growth.grows: how convincing the call and how long they hold

abilities.name: Chrome Grip
abilities.description: Lock your cyber hand around a handle or ledge and hang there until you choose to let go.
abilities.cost: The hand stays numb for an hour after

abilities.name: Corp Speak
abilities.description: Speak in flawless corporate jargon so a mid-level employee believes you belong upstairs.
abilities.cost: Fails the moment someone asks for your manager's name

growth.grows: how senior a person it fools

abilities.name: Dead Pixel Eye
abilities.description: Hold your gaze on a screen to see one hidden window or deleted message still in its cache.
abilities.cost: Optic implant flickers and blurs for a minute

growth.grows: how deep into the cache and how much you recover

abilities.name: Fixer's Favor
abilities.description: Call a fixer contact who can find one item or name for you by the next morning.
abilities.cost: Every favor is owed back with interest

growth.grows: how rare a request your contacts can fill
